study.title: SYN-217 Unified Oncology Trial
study.indication: Advanced non-small-cell lung cancer after prior systemic therapy
study.scope: One fictional trial. Medical, task, consent and support requirements are modeled for every patient. A modeled match is not enrollment approval.

protocol.wording: Authored fictional protocol; medical and participation requirements must all pass. Not a clinically validated protocol.

criteria.title: Index oncology requirements
criteria.original: Advanced NSCLC with at least one prior systemic treatment line.

criteria.title: Medication interactions
criteria.original: No strong CYP3A inhibitor; completed medication review identifies no relevant concern.

criteria.title: HIV inclusion pathway
criteria.original: Original: HIV-positive status excludes. Proposed: negative, or viral load <200 copies/mL, CD4 ≥200 cells/µL, suppression ≥90 days and no relevant ART interaction.

criteria.title: Brain-metastasis inclusion pathway
criteria.original: Original: brain metastases exclude. Proposed: absent, or accepted treatment OR stability ≥28 days, controlled/absent neurological symptoms and no relevant concern.

criteria.title: Age policy
criteria.original: Original: age ≤75. Proposed: no upper age limit; the adult and functional requirements still apply.

criteria.title: Controlled cardiac history
criteria.original: Original: cardiac history excludes. Proposed: an explicitly controlled history is permitted; unstable cardiac disease still fails.

criteria.title: Current comorbidity assessment
criteria.original: Current comorbidities are explicitly absent or controlled.

criteria.title: Required task completion
criteria.original: Original: required tasks satisfied independently. Proposed: independently OR with confirmed, task-specific support and documented task completion.

criteria.title: Required procedures
criteria.original: Required procedure review is explicitly accepted. Pending review is unknown.

criteria.title: Consent process
criteria.original: Original: accepted independent standard consent process. Proposed: that process OR an explicitly accepted assisted method with confirmed support.

criteria.title: Assessment method and support
criteria.original: The assessment method is accepted and any required communication support is actually confirmed.

criteria.title: Other-malignancy inclusion pathway
criteria.original: Original: another prior/concurrent malignancy excludes. Proposed: permitted when explicit endpoint, safety and treatment assessments identify no relevant interference. Index NSCLC is not this other malignancy.

criteria.title: Pregnancy assessment
criteria.original: Not pregnant OR explicitly documented clinical non-applicability. Gender never determines this result. Pregnancy remains a restriction in both protocols.

criteria.title: Renal inclusion pathway
criteria.original: Original: eGFR ≥60. Proposed: eGFR ≥45 mL/min/1.73 m² with an explicitly documented stable renal assessment.
